desc:
🚢 Welcome to Merge a Navy!

How to Play:
🔀 Merge 2 matching Ships to create a higher Tier  
⚓ Higher Tiers have more Health & DPS  
🏝️ Conquer Islands and expand your control  
⚔️ Battle other players for Loot  
🎁 Take part in random Events  
🚢 Build stronger Ships and create the ultimate Fleet  
👑 Rule the seas and conquer everything!

🔥 Merge, upgrade, conquer — and build the best Navy!
